title: Second run: every non-combat skill
summary: Every skill the rules can time reaches 99 in 12.3 to 12.8 days for an optimized player and about 23 days for a typical one, at the new 6.25 % pace. No stretch anywhere is a wall. Fifteen stretches of more than a day with nothing new, all from level 60 up, went to the content session. Eight rulings were approved today.
checked: Pace, all twelve skills: no level is slower than 1.3x the curve. The slowest is the end of Forestry's run from 81 to 98.
Empty stretches: 33 flagged. 15 last more than a day of typical play and are on the gaps list; 2 in Construction wait on its repeatable work; the rest last minutes or hours and are left alone.

Fishing: most of its old stretches were the page's mistake. It didn't count a catch with its own level (Salmon at 40, Lobster at 50, Swordfish at 63) as something new. Fishing now has 17 unlocks, not 8, and Cooked Salmon no longer shows as arriving at the start of the game.
Cooking and Smithing (first run, same day): on the curve, no empty stretches, every new recipe pays more than the one before.
Not checked yet: the ledger's own timing. The ledger read-out isn't built and the plan isn't in the CMS, so these are the page's numbers only.
moved: Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: the pace step's range is 6 % to 6.5 % a level, to tighten the late game; the page uses 6.25 %, the middle, until the boosts are balanced. Level 98 takes 18 hours instead of 22.5, levels 81 to 98 take 8.4 days optimized and 16 typical (were 10 and 20), and levels 1 to 60 barely change.
Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: a gap for content is a stretch of more than a day of typical play with nothing new.
Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: the optimized player's boosts climb level by level between tiers, so a new tier's first recipes never pay less than the old tier's last.
Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: gear takes 50 % longer for each bar past the first. A Chestplate takes 3x a Dagger.
Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: a recipe with a made base takes 1 of each raw ingredient at every level.
Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: a Fletching craft makes 40 arrows; a bar makes 40 Arrowheads or 40 Kunai, or 5 Nails.
Approved by the owner, 2026-11-25: a drink lasts 50 work cycles and a craft makes 5.

Fixed: a Token no longer moves off the level of what it gives, and a catch stays on the level of the recipe that uses it. The page had moved the Oyster Bed, the Clay Deposit, the Hollow Tree and Seaweed away from their items. 12 unlocks still move, each by 3 levels, to break up a thin stretch.
Fixed earlier today: food costed like armour, Water counts, unlocks moving below an ingredient, and action lengths trimmed so whole XP pays exactly.
gaps: 15 stretches are open for the content session, in docs/active/balance_gaps.md. The longest: Forestry 81 to 98 (17 days typical on Ebony alone), Fletching 86 to 98 and Crafting 87 to 98 (13 days each), Farming 88 to 98 (12 days).
Nine of the fifteen are a skill's last run to 99. Smithing and Cooking don't have one, because they have something new at 98 and 99.
waiting: On the owner: the CMS Ledger's pace curve still holds the 6.5 % points (1 = 3 ... 99 = 1437). Set it to the 6.25 % points when convenient: 1 = 3, 10 = 5, 20 = 9, 30 = 17, 40 = 32, 50 = 59, 60 = 107, 70 = 197, 80 = 361, 90 = 661, 99 = 1141.

On the director: the ledger read-out and the ledger's new tiers and boost budget (brief 880, L1 to L3). The ledger's pace curve should use the 6.25 % points in BALANCE_RULES section 1, not the 6.5 % ones. With the first number pack: the new XP table (9.4 million XP to 99) and the drink's 50-cycle dose.
On the content session: the plan in the CMS as Planned entries, and the fifteen gaps. Also to look at: Arrowheads unlock later than the arrows that need them at every metal.

On the balancer: a work potion's dose and batch; Construction once its repeatable work is planned; and a rule for coins (the coin cost curve and what an item is worth), to propose to the owner before the coin pack.
